chapter: Cage on songs, cane work, records and family
title: Listening to Blind Lemon Jefferson and Bessie Smith records
summary: Cage says he listened to all the blues singers on record, naming Blind Lemon Jefferson and Bessie Smith; the interviewer keeps their records.
